$comment: Fixture product manifest template owned by OR-NATIVE-HARNESS. N-MAC/N-WIN instantiate it per scenario to install a supervised fixture product whose serviceStart is the shipped, executable lifecycle-fixture.mjs (tests/native/lifecycle-fixture.mjs). On Mac the script has a shebang and is chmod +x, so serviceStart[0] is the script itself and the Hub computes artifactDigest = sha256(script). On Windows N-WIN stages a launcher as serviceStart[0] (e.g. a node-SEA or .cmd) with its own stamped digest. N-MAC/N-WIN replace <fixture-child> with the absolute executable path, <scenario> with the scenario under test, <fixture-install-root> with the staged install dir, and stamp artifactDigest from serviceStart[0]'s bytes. The all-zero sentinel below is recognized by the harness self-check before stamping.
